entry.title: NIS-2: Kommission plant einen Durchführungsrechtsakt
entry.summary: The NIS2 Directive sets out obligations on essential and important entities in 18 critical sectors in the EU for the reporting of significant cybersecurity incidents. This act will provide common incident notification templates for notifications under the NIS2 Directive, thereby streamlining the format and the type of information to be notified across all 27 Member States and supporting the Commission’s broader simplification agenda. Förmlicher Titel: Commission Implementing Regulation further specifying the type of information, the format and the procedure of a notification submitted pursuant to Article 23(1) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Die Kommission erlässt ihn nach der Stellungnahme der Mitgliedstaaten im Ausschuss „Cybersecurity Committee“ (Verfahren: examination procedure (Art. 5, 6 and 7 of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011)). Ein Entwurf soll auf „Have your say“ zur Rückmeldung veröffentlicht werden.

entry.title: EU-Weltraumgesetz: Kompromisstext der Präsidentschaft
entry.summary: Presidency compromise text on the EU Space Act of 29 October 2026, a clean version without change marks sent by the General Secretariat of the Council for the meeting of 3 November 2026; all delegations have a scrutiny reservation, so it is the Presidency's draft, not a Council position and not law, and it can still change. Compared with the clean text of March 2026, it adds market surveillance by Member States under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, lets a Member State self-certify spacecraft with substantial governmental involvement without a qualified technical body, narrows the obligation on space-based data to Earth observation data supplied to public contracting authorities and Union bodies (plus a landing-rights criterion for satellite communication), replaces the defence exclusions, and turns the environmental footprint into a life-cycle assessment with a standardisation request for the Union method. The cybersecurity provisions, which oblige space operators that are NIS-2 entities to follow the NIS-2 implementing act for space and apply equivalent measures to the other operators, and the incident reporting rules are unchanged apart from wording and corrected cross-references.
